description: This file contains unit tests for the 'quiche' project's 'quiche_circular_deque' data structure, including tests for constructors, assignment, element access, iteration, resizing, relocation, push/pop operations, allocator behavior, and swap functionality.

classes.name: CountingAllocator
classes.description: A custom allocator template that tracks allocation and deallocation counts, used for testing allocator behavior.

classes.name: ConfigurableAllocator
classes.description: A template for allocators with configurable propagation traits and equality result, used for testing allocator propagation and swap behavior.

classes.name: Foo
classes.description: A simple class with dynamic memory to test relocation and copy semantics within the deque.

classes.name: QuicheCircularDequeTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for running various unit tests on the QuicheCircularDeque data structure.

methods.name: ShiftRight
methods.description: Shifts elements in a deque to the right, wrapping the last element to the front.

methods.name: ShiftLeft
methods.description: Shifts elements in a deque to the left, wrapping the first element to the back.
